captions.detailed: This is a wall-mounted air purifier with a light gray rectangular main housing, featuring black corner trim and mounting brackets on its back. The front cover is a light gray panel covered in a grid of horizontal ventilation slots, equipped with a dark gray vertical handle on the right and three cylindrical hinges on the left. The front cover rotates outward on its vertical hinges, while an internal filter drawer slides forward along bottom rails.
captions.instruction: Create a CadQuery model of a wall-mounted air purifier. The assembly should feature a rectangular main body with mounting brackets, a front cover detailed with a grid of ventilation slots and a vertical handle, and a revolute joint on the left side allowing the front cover to swing open.
captions.factory: Construct the main body box and subtract material to hollow it out, then add rear mounting tabs and black frame borders. For the door, create a flat panel, generate a grid of slotted ventilation holes using a loop of subtracted box primitives, and attach a simple handle block. Finally, model cylindrical hinges on the left side and define a revolute joint axis along their center to connect the door to the main body.
